about: Walter Decision — needs declared by the modules that ask typed decisions (llm/decision.py). A caller names its need in the request (walter_memory.llm.decide sends its processor). Policy only: the Router's decision chain chooses and orders the models. memo_ttl_s = window in which the same state + questions + chain reuse the answer already given (0 = never); escalate_below = confidence under which a question is asked again to the next model of the chain (null = off until a bench sets it); max_timeout_s = cap on the caller's timeout per call (null = the caller's). assign (18/11) = "native_whole": the whole set in one call to the first model of the chain that carries it all natively, hedge_after_ms = a second call only past that, failover_after_ms = the per-question split starts past that or on an error (first complete answer wins); media_fallback "text" = a medium no usable model reads is left out of the split rather than the question (the state says it in words); settle_after_ms = past it, parts of the split that carry only optional questions are no longer waited for (said late). types = the question kinds the need asks today (noul, choice, score, multiple = choice of several options, text, number, date, estimate = number with a range, spans, box, boxes); new_kinds = kinds that fit its purpose and that a route can carry since 17/11, with where (not asked yet: the owning module adopts them). Each kind is checked against the decision chain by `walter-router decision-needs` (llm/decision.py capabilities: native, Extractions route, emulated, or refused).

walter-context-preflight.purpose: plan of each owner message: thread, act, context level, tier, modules

new_kinds.multiple: since 18/11 native on Liquid's own API (independent probabilities, one call): `needs` and `personal`; emulated as one noul per option only on the failover split (Drex Max, OpenRouter)
new_kinds.spans: since 18/11 asked in the same native call as the judgements (dates, people, places, amounts); on the failover split, OpenRouter's Extractions route

walter-context-preflight.policy_18_11: owner decision 18/11 (mission « préflight natif »): native_whole on Liquid's own API, hedge past 700 ms, split failover past 1.5 s or on error, media_fallback text. Bench preflight_native (65 cases, 2 independent runs): decision p50/p95 0.44/0.60 s (was 0.57/0.79), ~1 call per message (was 2.9), same act/needs, personal/pack/readings now read; outage drill without Liquid: 11/11 answered. Rollback = remove these four keys.

triage.purpose: incoming event: ignore / remember / notify / prepare a reply

new_kinds.number: since 17/11 (2.0): the amount of the last incoming message (EUR), read by Walter when the model finds it without its value
new_kinds.date: since 17/11: the deadline, read by Walter against the message's day (order dmy)
new_kinds.text: the person to answer (not asked yet)

views.purpose: organic memory views: subject / episode / period assignment

disclosure.commitment.purpose: does an outgoing message commit the owner

new_kinds.spans: since 17/11 (2.0): the days an outgoing message commits to (resolved by Walter); every piece of personal data (17/11: 13/13 found on Walter cases) not asked yet
new_kinds.number: since 17/11: the amount it commits to

documents.verify.purpose: check a fact drawn from a document against it

new_kinds.text: the value a fact claims, read from the document with its span

sourced-observation/1.verify.purpose: check an observation against its source

context-intent-bench.purpose: bench of the intent questions (never reused: each sample counts)

memory.reconcile.purpose: consolidation: how each statement extracted from a conversation relates to current knowledge (target item + new / confirms / enriches / corrects / replaces / contradicts / ignore), up to 12 statements per decision
